title: Legal Analyst, Office of the CEO
description:
Analyst, Office of the CEO

Location: Bogotá, Colombia

About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking talented and motivated Legal Analyst to join the Office of the CEO, working directly with our Manager of the Office of the CEO to drive the strategic and operational priorities of Sezzle's CEO. This is not a traditional analyst role. You will function as an executive-grade project manager: the person who gets things done across the organization, removes obstacles for leadership, and turns ambiguous directives into clear outcomes.

We are hiring multiple analysts. The bar is high. We hire ambitious recent graduates with exceptional academic records, high IQ, high EQ, and a relentless drive to deliver. You will sit inside the executive wing, reporting through the Chief of Staff to the CEO, and you will be exposed to the full operational and strategic agenda of a publicly traded fintech (Nasdaq: SEZL) on its path to becoming a bank.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. We start compensation modest and reward performance aggressively. Top performers move quickly. Underperformance is addressed directly.

What You'll Do

  • Own and drive legal and cross-functional projects originating from the Office of the CEO, from kickoff to delivery, holding stakeholders and outside counsel accountable to commitments and deadlines.
  • Conduct legal and regulatory research on business, market, and operational questions, delivering crisp, decision-ready synthesis rather than raw research dumps.
  • Prepare materials for executive meetings, board interactions, and investor touchpoints, including legal briefing notes, agendas, decks, data summaries, and post-meeting action trackers.
  • Track corporate governance items, entity management, and compliance deadlines, surfacing risks and blockers early with proposed solutions.
  • Build and maintain automation and AI-enabled workflows that scale the legal and administrative productivity of the Office of the CEO; if it can be automated, automate it.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Engineering, Product, Finance, People, and Marketing to keep executive and legal priorities moving in parallel.
  • Act as a trusted, discreet extension of executive and legal leadership; handle confidential and privileged information with absolute integrity.

What We Look For

  • Education: Recent graduate (or graduating within 6 months) from a top Colombian university with a law degree (Derecho).
  • Major: Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or related quantitative discipline. Finance fundamentals are the basis of everything we do.
  • Academic record: Strong GPA and demonstrated intellectual discipline. We review transcripts. Excellence in subjects you did not personally love is a signal we value.
  • Cognitive ability: High IQ, fast learner, comfortable holding multiple variables in your head at once. Candidates complete a Wonderlic cognitive assessment as part of our process.
  • Project management instinct: Natural orientation to break work down, sequence it, hold people accountable, and close loops. You finish what you start.
  • AI and automation fluency: Daily, comfortable user of modern AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, similar). Able to design prompts, build simple automations, and use AI to compress hours of work into minutes.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Operational excellence: Obsessively organized. Calendars, trackers, follow-ups, and documents in order. Nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Communication: Clear, concise, professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Comfortable communicating with senior executives.
  • Maturity and discretion: Exposed to confidential information from day one. Trustworthy, composed, and professional under pressure.
  • Language: Must be fluent in English and Spanish

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship or work experience in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, fintech, or a high-growth startup.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial activity: founded a club, organized an event, ran a side project, built a small product or business.
  • Leadership experience at university (student government, case competitions, conferences, sports leadership)
  • In possession of a B1/B2 US Visa
  • Familiarity with financial modeling, data analysis tools (Excel, Google Sheets, SQL basics), and presentation design.

About You

  • You have relentlessly high standards (many people may think your standards are unreasonably high). You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention. Your success, and much of the fun, lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action. Speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit. You can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results. You focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation

The starting compensation for this role is approximately $1,500 - $2,000 USD per month, with clear performance milestones and significant upside for high performers. Our ranges are broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth.

This is an in-office role based at our Bogotá hub, within the Sezzle executive wing.
